Welcome

Red Door Cafe is a much-loved Edenvale coffee shop, rated 4.5 stars from over 1,000 reviews. Come in for good coffee, tasty food and a warm welcome by the fireplace.

Why Red Door Cafe

  • A quaint hidden gem with eclectic decor and a cosy fireplace
  • Friendly, welcoming staff who make every visit feel special
  • Rated 4.5 stars by over 1,000 happy customers

Services

Fresh Coffee

Well-loved coffee, made to enjoy in the cafe and savoured slowly.

Breakfast

Start your morning with food served from 7:00 AM on most days.

Light Lunches

Filling yet light lunch options, ideal for a relaxed midday break.

Client Lunches

A pleasant spot to take clients or colleagues out for lunch.

Lunch Dates

Relaxed, friendly surroundings for catching up with friends or someone special.

Cosy Fireside Seating

Settle in beside the fireplace among eclectic, characterful decor.
